searchText: is it correct https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/electra/p2p-interface.md doesn't mention attester slashings anywhere? > The `beacon_aggregate_and_proof` and `beacon_attestation_{subnet_id}` topics are modified to support the gossip of the new attestation type. but attester slashings change too The type has changed, but rules remain the same. Would it require any engineering work? Or topics are switched anyway between the forks? I think we can add a note to the spec at least it should be basically the same, but it's weird to not even mention it, since it is also "modified to support the gossip of the new attestation type" either mention none or all but mention some suggests rest not yeah it's just a documentation issue could you please take a look and approve if it looks fine to you, https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3941 done, lgtm thank you! Hi <@425572898787426305> I think I found partial withdrawals bug in the current spec. More writeup here: https://hackmd.io/@ttsao/S13TVqkA0 very good catch! would you like to open the PR with the proposed fix? Or I can do it if you prefer Feel free to do it : ) i'll also write a test for it
